propositions: CLI --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread flags on _build-and-test.yml shared-tier lanes permanently shadow ini changes carried in patchsets, preventing per-test-budget fixes from being exercised by their own Verified runs
pytest-timeout resolves precedence CLI > env > ini, so flags from trusted-main workflow files cannot be overridden by changes to pyproject.toml in the patchset

Removal of --timeout and --timeout-method CLI flags from both shared-tier lanes (default-suite and integration) with ini-only governance maintains effective budget (300 s, thread method) while enabling patchset ini changes to be tested by their own gate run
Conftest-floor mechanism for timeout hardening is rejected due to pytest-timeout's read-only config resolution at session start with no supported hook point

The hang-guard sweep must be rewritten to assert flag-free shared-tier lanes inherit the ini budget (timeout positive, timeout_method=thread) while requiring all other pytest lanes to carry explicit --timeout flags with thread method
The effective budget remains unchanged (300 s, thread method) before and after flag removal; only the authority moves from CLI to ini
